timing: Gold and execution settings already frozen; report implementation during ongoing agent pass, before any post pass result. No frozen input/gold changed.
unit: One whole paraphrased post/item per direct-agent result; aggregate of checked extracted rows for post CLI, matching phase 1.
primary_false_supported: Overall supported aggregate on a primary-source contradicted item. A correctly supported true component inside a refuted compound post is not itself false support. Component-level false support cannot be estimated without explicit component alignment.
scope_false_supported: Any supported extracted component, including partial failures, on a scope-only item remains a false-supported scope expectation, as in phase 1.
accuracy: All primary gold cases remain in denominator; failed, missing, budget-stopped and skipped positive cases count wrong. Scope expectations and unresolved review items are excluded from primary factual accuracy.
media: No factual accuracy or OCR recall denominator; report operational outcomes, extraction/checking counts, all latencies and all billed-provider ledger debits.
